This is a Signature-original design study, explicitly labeled and never presented as public record. Baseline reference: High-altitude reconnaissance aircraft; service from 1956; 104 built by Lockheed; still flying.. The U-2 Dragon Lady is a single-engine high-altitude reconnaissance aircraft built by Lockheed, entering service in 1956. Flying above 70,000 feet, it photographed denied territory through the Cold War and beyond; one was shot down over the Soviet Union in 1960. 104 were built; upgraded U-2S aircraft still fly today.
